name: Apply AHE to TanStack chat harness while keeping bundle lean

description: Baseline AHE session setup and current chat harness bundle measurement

asi.hypothesis: Establish an observability-driven loop inspired by AHE: explicit files in scope, reproducible bundle metric, and typecheck backpressure before changing harness structure.
asi.paper_applied: Mapped AHE component/experience/decision observability to autoresearch.md scope, METRIC output, checks, and ASI hypotheses.
asi.user_changes_note: Repository had pre-existing uncommitted chat changes; baseline keep records the current app state plus autoresearch harness on the autoresearch branch.

description: Replace heavy markdown dependency path with lightweight safe inline renderer

asi.hypothesis: AHE structural simplification: markdown rendering is a component-level harness service; replacing general GFM dependencies with a focused renderer for chat needs should preserve common formatting while reducing client payload.
asi.outcome: Large primary improvement by removing react-markdown/remark-gfm from the client import graph; typecheck and build still pass.
asi.tradeoff: Renderer supports paragraphs, ordered/unordered lists, fenced code, inline code, and http/mailto links, but not full GFM tables/task lists. This is acceptable for tutorial chat unless full GFM is a hard requirement.

description: Replace Radix controls with native form controls for lean harness UI

asi.hypothesis: Component observability exposed Radix Select/Toggle/Tooltip/ScrollArea as heavyweight UI harness components. Native select/button/title/scroll containers should preserve tutorial functionality and accessibility while reducing dependencies in the client graph.
asi.outcome: Primary bundle metric improved substantially; build and typecheck pass. Native controls keep model selection, toggles, scrolling, and send/stop affordances.
asi.tradeoff: Custom popper styling/check icons/tooltips were simplified to browser-native controls; acceptable because behavior remains clear and the app becomes more transferable/less framework-specific.

description: Split client request-search tool definition from server-only tool implementations

asi.hypothesis: AHE component observability suggests client and server tool components need explicit file boundaries. Moving request_search_query to a small shared module should keep the client from pulling demo weather/stock/Brave server tool definitions into the route chunk.
asi.outcome: Bundle improved modestly; build and typecheck pass. Client Chat now imports only the interactive tool definition it actually needs.
asi.transferable_lesson: File-level component boundaries matter for bundlers: mixed client/server tool modules can leak unnecessary harness structure into browser code.

description: Use plain JSON Schema for browser-side interactive tool definition

asi.hypothesis: Decision observability from the prior split showed the remaining shared client tool still carried Zod. TanStack AI accepts plain JSON Schema, so using JSON Schema for the client-visible request_search_query contract should preserve provider/tool metadata while dropping Zod from browser bundles.
asi.outcome: Large improvement; build and typecheck pass. The schema remains explicit and serializable, matching AHE's preference for file-level, inspectable component contracts.
asi.tradeoff: Lost Zod-inferred static arg typing for this one client tool definition, but Chat already narrows tool input at runtime and the schema contract remains precise.

description: Try plain client tool object instead of toolDefinition.client wrapper

asi.hypothesis: A plain AnyClientTool-shaped object might avoid importing toolDefinition code into the browser while preserving the client tool contract.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed slightly; likely because the shared request-search-tool module still imports toolDefinition for the server definition, so the client chunk did not avoid the import and added wrapper code.
asi.next_action_hint: If revisiting, split schema constants into a third module that has no @tanstack/ai import, with separate server definition and client plain-object factory files.

description: Split request-search schema constants and use plain client tool object

asi.hypothesis: Separating schema constants from the server toolDefinition import should let the browser use a plain client tool object without pulling server definition code.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric still regressed slightly versus the prior best; @tanstack/ai-react/@tanstack/ai-client likely already bring the relevant runtime, and the extra factory/module boundary adds overhead.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the simpler toolDefinition.client setup. Focus next on actual route/UI code or server bundle rather than this micro-split.

description: Remove identity clientTools wrapper and unused AG-UI status local

asi.hypothesis: Experience from the previous failed micro-splits suggests avoiding extra identity helpers may yield small wins without changing harness behavior. useChat accepts the tool array directly, and latestAgUiStatus was unused.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; typecheck confirms the direct tools array is accepted.
asi.transferable_lesson: Prefer direct data contracts over convenience wrappers when the wrapper is only an identity function in hot client harness code.

description: Export TanStack Start handler directly from server entry

asi.hypothesis: Component observability shows the server entry wrapped the TanStack Start fetch handler without adding behavior. Removing this adapter should slightly reduce harness surface area and bundle output while preserving semantics.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.transferable_lesson: AHE-style component audits can safely delete pass-through middleware when it has no observability or policy function.

description: Trim redundant false debug flags from chat server route

asi.hypothesis: Decision observability in the chat middleware should keep only active diagnostics. Explicit false debug fields add serialized code surface without changing behavior if defaults are false.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; error logging remains enabled through the custom logger.
asi.risk_note: Assumes TanStack AI debug defaults are false for omitted fields, consistent with the previous explicit configuration.

description: Factor tool label ternary into helper

asi.hypothesis: Replacing a long inline ternary with a helper might reduce repeated render code and improve component readability without changing behavior.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed; helper function overhead outweighed any minification benefit for a single call site.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not factor single-use render expressions purely for bundle size. Only extract when there are multiple call sites or readability is worth neutral/slight cost.

description: Replace server tool Zod schemas with plain JSON Schema

asi.hypothesis: Using plain JSON Schema for all server tool definitions might remove Zod from the server bundle, mirroring the successful browser-side request_search_query change.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed; Zod was apparently not materially bundled in the measured server output or the verbose JSON Schema literals outweighed any removal.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep Zod for server-only tools where it improves maintainability and inferred contracts. Plain JSON Schema is only beneficial for client-visible schemas.

description: Remove StrictMode wrapper from production hydration entry

asi.hypothesis: The client entry's StrictMode wrapper is a development diagnostic component, not core harness behavior. Removing it from this tutorial production entry should slightly reduce client code without affecting production semantics.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: React StrictMode's extra development checks are no longer applied at runtime. If this project relies on StrictMode during local dev, consider a dev-only wrapper instead.

description: Hydrate StartClient directly without startTransition wrapper

asi.hypothesis: The hydration entry can be a direct component handoff; startTransition is another pass-through wrapper that adds code but does not change steady-state chat harness behavior.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: If future startup work becomes expensive, a transition wrapper could be reintroduced for scheduling. Current entry has no visible pending UI to benefit from it.

description: Remove scrollRestoration option from single-page chat router

asi.hypothesis: For this single-page chat tutorial, router scroll restoration is not a meaningful harness capability. Removing the option should slightly reduce route/router configuration surface without affecting current navigation behavior.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: If the app grows multiple scrollable routes, revisit scroll restoration as a UX feature rather than a default.

description: Simplify follow-up custom event guard

asi.hypothesis: A trust-but-filter helper for server-generated follow-up events might be smaller than a Boolean type guard with Array.every validation while preserving runtime safety.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed slightly; the filter helper added more code than the compact Boolean guard after minification/gzip.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep existing custom event guard. Avoid micro-optimizing validation code unless it removes a dependency or repeated branch.

description: Remove artificial delays from demo weather and stock tools

asi.hypothesis: AHE experience observability should report real tool progress, not synthetic latency. Removing demo-only sleeps should make tool runs faster and slightly shrink server harness code while preserving status events and outputs.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved and the demo tools become more responsive; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: The AG-UI status panel may advance too quickly to notice for local demo weather/stock tools, but live Brave search still shows real latency.

description: Compress chat system prompt while preserving tool policy

asi.hypothesis: Although AHE ablations caution against prompt-only overemphasis, the existing system prompt had redundant prose. A concise policy should preserve tool routing/citation behavior, lower server bundle text, and reduce prompt tokens per request.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. This also slightly reduces per-chat prompt tokens without removing any tool instructions.
asi.risk_note: Need monitor real conversations for routing quality; if ambiguous search handling or demo-data disclaimers degrade, revert despite bundle win.

description: Shorten tool descriptions and request-search schema descriptions

asi.hypothesis: Concise tool descriptions should preserve tool semantics while shrinking server/client schema text and reducing model prompt/tool tokens.
asi.rollback_reason: Edit introduced a syntax error in request-search-tool.ts, likely due a missing comma while replacing nested schema description fields.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry carefully with full-file inspection or smaller edits; the idea remains promising because prompt compression just improved the metric.

description: Shorten tool and schema descriptions while preserving semantics

asi.hypothesis: Concise tool descriptions should retain enough routing/schema signal for the model while shrinking serialized tool contracts in client/server output and reducing request tokens.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. The prior syntax-error attempt was corrected with targeted replacements.
asi.risk_note: Monitor tool-call quality; if the model stops choosing tools correctly, restore more descriptive wording even if bundle grows.

description: Compress model follow-up generation prompt

asi.hypothesis: The follow-up route prompt can be shorter while preserving the JSON-only contract and quality constraints, reducing server bundle text and per-call prompt tokens.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Monitor generated follow-up quality for generic/repeated questions; concise prompt keeps the key constraints but less explanatory prose.

description: Shorten AG-UI chat status labels

asi.hypothesis: Shorter status labels should preserve progress observability while reducing server/client text.
asi.rollback_reason: Build crashed in TanStack route component split for /api/chat with a generated JSX parse error. The edit only changed strings, so this appears to trigger a fragile route-splitting edge case rather than a semantic TypeScript error.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid further edits to status labels in src/routes/api/chat.ts unless first investigating TanStack Start route splitting. Focus on safer files or inspect generated split output.

description: Hoist Metric component style object

asi.hypothesis: Hoisting a reused inline style object in ToolWidget could reduce per-render allocation and maybe shrink emitted code.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed slightly; the style object is only used in one component and gzip/minification handle the inline literal well.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not hoist single-use or low-reuse styles for bundle size. Larger CSS/class refactors would need a metric that includes CSS gzip to avoid shifting bytes out of JS.

description: Limit lightweight markdown links to http(s) URLs

asi.hypothesis: The chat assistant primarily cites web URLs; mailto markdown links are not a core harness need. Dropping mailto support from the focused renderer should slightly shrink client code while preserving citation links.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Markdown mailto links now render as plain text. Acceptable for this chat/search tutorial unless email-link rendering becomes a requirement.

description: Compute filtered model options directly instead of useMemo

asi.hypothesis: Filtering the small model list directly can be simpler than a memoization hook. AHE favors deleting control machinery when the underlying operation is cheap and observable outcomes remain correct.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; typecheck/build pass. useMemo remains where it creates stable tool definitions or avoids heavier follow-up recomputation.
asi.risk_note: If model lists become extremely large, direct filtering each render may be revisited, but OpenRouter model counts are modest for UI rendering.

description: Replace heuristic follow-up useMemo with helper function

asi.hypothesis: Deleting another memoization hook for cheap heuristic follow-up generation might simplify the component and reduce bundle size.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed. Moving the logic to a helper increased gzip slightly despite similar raw size; the existing inline useMemo is better for both runtime and bundle here.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep useMemo for heavier derived data tied to messages. The direct-filter win does not generalize to multi-step message scanning.

description: Shorten localStorage keys for chat settings

asi.hypothesis: Local memory keys are part of the harness contract but do not need verbose prefixes in a tutorial app. Short keys should preserve future persistence behavior while shrinking client literals.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: Existing browser preferences under old keys will not be migrated, so users may need to reselect model/settings once. A migration would add code and outweigh the bundle win.

description: Shorten internal custom event names for follow-ups and statuses

asi.hypothesis: Custom event names are internal client/server harness contracts. Shortening them should preserve behavior while reducing repeated literals across chat route, tools, and UI event handling.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass. Event payload shape and UI behavior are unchanged.
asi.risk_note: External code listening for demo.status/tool.status/followups.generated would break. In this tutorial app those names are internal; document if they become public API.

description: Use compact internal codes for follow-up mode values

asi.hypothesis: Follow-up mode values are internal UI/storage codes while option labels remain user-facing. Compact codes should shrink repeated comparison/storage literals without changing visible behavior.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: Stored follow-up mode values become less self-describing in localStorage. This is acceptable after shortening storage keys; labels and TypeScript union preserve source clarity enough.

description: Shorten server tool status labels

asi.hypothesis: Tool status labels are user-visible but can be concise. Shorter labels should preserve experience observability while reducing repeated server/client text.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved below 140kb; build and typecheck pass. Status panel still communicates progress for weather, stock, and Brave search.
asi.risk_note: Concise labels carry less explanatory prose but remain understandable in context.

description: Shorten AG-UI status panel title

asi.hypothesis: Changing the panel label from 'AG-UI live' to 'Live' might slightly reduce client text while keeping the status UI understandable.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric was slightly worse within tiny/noisy range; gzip effects did not favor this label change.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid user-facing copy micro-edits for byte savings unless they clearly improve the primary metric or UX.

description: Drop CRLF normalization from lightweight markdown parser

asi.hypothesis: Chat content streamed from APIs is normalized enough that explicit CRLF-to-LF replacement is unnecessary. Removing it should shrink the focused renderer with minimal behavior impact.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: If a message contains Windows CRLF line endings, rendered lines may retain trailing carriage returns in rare cases. Acceptable for this tutorial chat renderer.

description: Support standard dotted ordered lists only in markdown parser

asi.hypothesis: Markdown ordered lists overwhelmingly use '1.' syntax. Dropping '1)' support keeps common assistant step formatting while shrinking parser regexes.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: Ordered lists written as '1)' now render as paragraphs. This is acceptable for a focused chat renderer.

description: Support dash unordered lists only in markdown parser

asi.hypothesis: Assistant markdown typically uses dash bullets. Dropping asterisk bullet support should slightly shrink regexes while retaining common list rendering.
asi.outcome: Very small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: Asterisk-prefixed bullets now render as paragraphs. If broader markdown fidelity is needed, restore this or use a full markdown renderer despite bundle cost.

description: Shorten model-loading fallback error messages

asi.hypothesis: Fallback error strings can be concise without hiding actionable provider errors, because actual Error messages are still passed through when available.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass. Added a deferred high-risk custom useChat idea to autoresearch.ideas.md.
asi.risk_note: Generic fallback copy is shorter but less specific; actual OpenRouter/API errors remain detailed.

description: Shorten chat API fallback error strings

asi.hypothesis: Concise chat API fallback errors should preserve actionable meaning while shrinking server literals.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed slightly after gzip despite raw bytes decreasing; existing wording compressed better with other OpenRouter-related strings.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not pursue more OpenRouter/error-copy micro-edits unless changing larger duplicated blocks.

description: Simplify OpenRouter thinking-support heuristic

asi.hypothesis: Thinking support detection can be expressed as compact parameter/name substring checks instead of several explicit includes plus a regex. This should preserve broad detection while shrinking server model-catalog code.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: Heuristic no longer specially detects standalone o1/o3/o4/r1 tokens unless supported_parameters or model text includes one of the retained terms. Most current reasoning models advertise reasoning params or recognizable family names.

description: Collapse text-chat model modality checks into one return

asi.hypothesis: The OpenRouter text-chat predicate can be a single negated expression instead of three early returns, preserving filtering semantics with less emitted control flow.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Readability is slightly denser, but the predicate remains localized and covered by typecheck/build.

description: Use Boolean wrapper for free-model suffix check

asi.hypothesis: Boolean(model.id?.endsWith(':free')) may minify/gzip slightly better than optional chaining with nullish coalescing while preserving the same false fallback.
asi.outcome: Very small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: No semantic risk expected: undefined ids still become false.

description: Simplify follow-up JSON parsing pipeline

asi.hypothesis: Collapsing parseFollowUps filter/map/filter/slice into a compact conditional expression might shrink server code.
asi.rollback_reason: Although primary improved, the simplified pipeline no longer returned trimmed follow-up strings, causing a subtle user-facing quality regression. Correctness/UX degradation is not worth this micro win.
asi.next_action_hint: If retrying, preserve trimming semantics; expect the metric benefit to shrink or disappear.

description: Simplify follow-up parsing while preserving trimming with flatMap

asi.hypothesis: A flatMap-based parser could preserve string trimming while reducing the filter/map/filter pipeline.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed versus the prior best; preserving trimming removes the apparent benefit of the previous unsafe simplification.
asi.next_action_hint: Leave parseFollowUps as-is. It is clearer and gzips better than the flatMap variant.

description: Use numeric literal for OpenRouter model cache TTL

asi.hypothesis: The model cache TTL is a fixed constant; using `6e5` preserves the 10-minute value with a smaller emitted expression.
asi.outcome: Very small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Readability of the duration is lower than `10 * 60 * 1000`, but the constant name still documents the purpose.

description: Use compact numeric timeout literals and shorter search schema hint

asi.hypothesis: Numeric separators in timeout literals and a slightly verbose search query schema hint add bytes without changing behavior. Compact literals preserve values; shorter hint preserves meaning.
asi.outcome: Very small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Mostly byte-level cleanup; readability is slightly lower for timeout values but call sites remain obvious.

description: Use exponential literal for 400-character search limit

asi.hypothesis: Changing repeated 400 literals to 4e2 might minify to fewer bytes while preserving the search query limit.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric was unchanged, and readability is worse. No reason to keep a neutral byte-level change.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop trying numeric literal micro-edits unless they show a measurable improvement.

description: Stop refetching model catalog when only free-only filter changes

asi.hypothesis: The free-only toggle is a local presentation filter over the already-loaded model catalog. Removing it from the catalog-loading effect dependencies should avoid unnecessary network work and slightly reduce client dependency code while preserving selection logic via handleFreeOnlyChange.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass. This is an AHE structural cleanup: model catalog fetching and local filtering are now more clearly separated.
asi.risk_note: Initial settings load still applies the stored free-only value before the models effect runs because settingsLoaded flips after reading storage. If React batching behavior changes, verify initial free-only selection manually.

description: Consolidate chat settings persistence effects

asi.hypothesis: AHE memory observability suggests settings persistence is one cohesive local-memory component, not four separate effects. Combining them should reduce hook/middleware surface while preserving the stored settings contract.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. Selected model still avoids writing empty values, while boolean/mode settings persist together after settings load.
asi.risk_note: A change to any setting now rewrites all persisted settings. This is harmless for localStorage-sized values and makes the persisted snapshot more consistent.

description: Factor repeated response-state clearing into helper

asi.hypothesis: The three state resets before new sends/follow-up clicks are repeated harness cleanup logic; factoring them could reduce duplication and improve component observability.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed; a local helper function cost more than the duplicated minified setter calls for two call sites.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not factor this reset block unless adding a third/fourth call site or changing reset semantics.

description: Shorten non-critical chat UI helper copy

asi.hypothesis: Several helper strings are user-facing but non-critical. Shorter loading/empty/placeholder copy should preserve usability while shrinking client literals.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. The main controls and labels remain clear.
asi.risk_note: Copy is terser. If onboarding clarity is prioritized over bundle size, restore the longer empty-state and placeholder text.

description: Shorten follow-up mode option labels

asi.hypothesis: Follow-up mode option labels can be concise because they are shown under a 'Follow-ups' control. Shorter labels preserve meaning while reducing client text.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: The 'Model' label is less explicit than 'Model call' but still understandable in context next to Heuristic/AG-UI/Off.

description: Shorten fallback copy in tool widgets

asi.hypothesis: Tool widgets have fallback strings that are rarely shown and can be concise without reducing normal tool output quality. Shorter fallbacks and search header should shrink client text.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Fallback labels are terser but still understandable when optional fields are absent.

description: Shorten button title tooltips

asi.hypothesis: Native title text on the Thinking and Send/Stop buttons can be concise because visible button labels already carry the core affordance. Shorter titles reduce client literals without changing behavior.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Titles are less explanatory for unavailable thinking support, but disabled state plus concise title remain accessible enough for this tutorial.

description: Shorten accessible labels for chat controls

asi.hypothesis: ARIA labels can be concise when adjacent visible text already clarifies the control. Shorter labels should preserve accessibility names while shrinking client text.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Accessible names are shorter but still meaningful: Free models, Thinking, and Message.

description: Shorten AG-UI status region accessible label

asi.hypothesis: The status panel's accessible region label can be 'Status' because the visible heading still says AG-UI live. This preserves accessibility while reducing a long literal.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: If multiple status regions are added later, a more specific aria-label may be needed again.

description: Shorten server-generated heuristic follow-up suggestions

asi.hypothesis: Server-generated follow-up suggestions can use concise question wording while preserving intent, reducing server literals and emitted route code.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. Suggestions remain actionable for weather, stocks, search, and generic answers.
asi.risk_note: Tone is terser. If conversational warmth is a product goal, longer suggestions may be preferable despite bundle cost.

description: Shorten client heuristic follow-up suggestions

asi.hypothesis: Client-side heuristic follow-ups can use concise question wording while preserving actionability, reducing client literals in the harness memory/experience layer.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Follow-up tone is more terse. The suggestions remain clear, but product copy preferences could justify longer wording.

description: Trim uncommon greetings from heuristic follow-up regex

asi.hypothesis: The short-greeting heuristic only needs common greetings/thanks for this tutorial. Removing uncommon 'yo'/'sup' alternatives should slightly shrink the client regex while preserving mainstream behavior.
asi.outcome: Small primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: 'yo' and 'sup' are no longer treated as too-short greetings; they will receive topic-specific follow-ups. This is acceptable for a focused tutorial.

description: Shorten auxiliary prompt, follow-up, and typing labels

asi.hypothesis: Auxiliary UI labels around interactive search, follow-up sections, and typing status can be concise without hiding functionality. This should reduce client literals while preserving accessible names.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Interactive search title is terser but still paired with the model-provided prompt and Search button.

description: Use compact prefixed localStorage keys

asi.hypothesis: After accepting compact local memory keys, shortening the per-setting suffixes further while keeping the `tc:` namespace should preserve collision resistance enough for this tutorial and reduce client literals.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.tradeoff: Existing preferences under previous `tc:model`/`tc:free` keys will not migrate. Keys are less self-describing in browser devtools but source constants retain meaning.

description: Remove SSR guards from localStorage helpers used only in effects

asi.hypothesis: Chat settings storage helpers are only called from client-side effects. Removing `typeof window` guards clarifies the component boundary (client effect memory) and reduces client code without changing runtime behavior.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Do not call these helpers during SSR/render. If storage access moves outside useEffect, reintroduce guards or split client-only helpers explicitly.

description: Collapse boolean localStorage parser

asi.hypothesis: The boolean storage parser can be a single expression preserving true/false/fallback semantics, reducing local-memory helper control flow.
asi.outcome: Tiny primary improvement; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Expression is denser but still straightforward: true string wins, false string disables, otherwise fallback.

description: Render typing indicator dots statically instead of mapping array

asi.hypothesis: The typing indicator always renders exactly three dots. Static spans remove array allocation/map logic and dynamic delay math, likely improving gzip even if raw JSX grows.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved despite raw bundle growth; build and typecheck pass. Runtime also avoids tiny per-render array/map work.
asi.tradeoff: Source is more repetitive. Since the dot count is fixed UI, repetition is acceptable.

description: Hoist repeated markdown list regexes

asi.hypothesis: The markdown parser repeats ordered/unordered list regex literals; hoisting them might reduce duplication and parser construction.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed. The added constant names/conditional expression gzip worse than duplicated compact regex literals.
asi.next_action_hint: Leave markdown list regexes inline; prior pattern simplifications were beneficial, hoisting is not.

description: Remove unused model/thinking fields from status custom events

asi.hypothesis: Experience observability should expose information the UI actually consumes. Status custom events only render label/progress, so dropping model/thinking fields reduces event payload and route code without changing visible behavior.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. Status panel behavior is unchanged.
asi.risk_note: External consumers of internal `s` custom events would no longer receive model/thinking metadata. This app treats those events as internal, not public API.

description: Remove unused tool identifier from status event payloads

asi.hypothesis: Tool progress custom events are consumed by a generic status panel that only validates label/progress. Removing the unused `tool` field keeps experience observability focused and shrinks server tool event code.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass. Status labels still identify weather/quote/search to users.
asi.risk_note: Internal `t` events no longer carry a machine-readable tool id. Reintroduce if downstream consumers need per-tool filtering.

description: Drop unused age/source fields from Brave search tool results

asi.hypothesis: The chat UI and citation policy only need Brave result title, URL, and description. Dropping age/source fields from the tool schema and mapped output should shrink server code and reduce tool-result tokens without compromising citations.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Assistant answers lose optional source/age metadata. If source branding or recency labels become required, reintroduce those fields.

description: Remove unused observedAt fields from demo weather and stock tools

asi.hypothesis: Demo weather/stock tools return `observedAt`, but neither UI widgets nor prompt policy use it. Removing timestamp schema/output avoids extra code and per-call token payload while preserving displayed tool results.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: Tool consumers no longer receive a timestamp. Since these are explicitly demo values, recency metadata was not meaningful.

description: Make server-only tool definition constants non-exported

asi.hypothesis: Non-exported server tool definition constants might let bundling/minification shrink module interface code without changing runtime behavior.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric was unchanged, so the edit adds no measured value and slightly reduces testability/reuse of definitions.
asi.next_action_hint: Leave exports as-is unless a real module-boundary need arises.

description: Remove unused output schema from interactive search request tool

asi.hypothesis: The `request_search_query` client tool needs an input contract for the model, but its output is a simple client-returned `{query}` consumed by the agent loop rather than UI validation. Omitting outputSchema should preserve behavior while shrinking the shared client/server tool definition.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: If TanStack AI or a future provider uses outputSchema for validation/tool result typing, this may need restoration. Current code already narrows the client callback return type explicitly.

description: Remove unused output schemas from server tools

asi.hypothesis: Provider tool calling requires input schemas; these server tools' output schemas are not consumed by UI or validation in this app. Omitting them should preserve execution while shrinking server tool definitions and reducing schema maintenance surface.
asi.outcome: Primary metric improved noticeably; build and typecheck pass.
asi.risk_note: If future TanStack AI versions validate tool outputs or expose output schemas to clients/docs, restore them. Current server execute functions still return the same output objects.

description: Replace remaining server tool Zod input schemas with JSON Schema

asi.hypothesis: After removing output schemas, plain JSON input schemas might beat Zod for server-only tool definitions and possibly remove Zod from the server bundle.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed; verbose JSON Schema literals still outweigh any benefit. Zod input schemas are more concise and maintainable here.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep Zod for server input contracts. Only use plain JSON Schema on client-visible request_search_query, where it previously removed browser Zod cost.

description: Restore TanStack Start server entry object shape for dev runtime

description: Add backpressure check for TanStack Start server default.fetch contract

description: Inline remaining chat UI types into Chat

description: Trust follow-up custom event is the only custom stream event
